run_upload_diff: run upload.py to upload diffs from git, mercurial, or subversion to the codereview app
run_GuessVCS: run GuessVCS to detect which version control system is active in the current directory
run_SplitPatch: run SplitPatch to split a unified diff string into per-file patch tuples
run_EncodeMultipartFormData: run EncodeMultipartFormData to encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data body
run_RealMain: run RealMain to execute the full upload workflow and return issue and patchset IDs
